subject: Request: encryption operational onboarding materials & proofs for Nova Health
messages:
From: Maya Chen <compliance@novahealth.com>
To: Hannah Schmitt <hannah_schmitt@redwood.com>
Cc: Ravi Patel <procurement@novahealth.com>
Date: Tue, 29 Sep 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Request: encryption operational onboarding materials & proofs for Nova Health

Hi Hannah,

Hope you’re well. As part of Nova Health’s vendor security intake for our integration pilot, our compliance team needs a compact operational package covering encryption and key management. Please provide the following items or point us to a secure location where we can retrieve them: 

- Operational playbook (how keys are provisioned, rotated, and retired)
- Key rotation schedule for the last 12 months and proposed cadence going forward (CSV preferred)
- HSM attestation / vendor certificate and model/serial numbers (if in use)
- Confirmation of BYOK options (customer-managed keys) and a short BYOK handshake guide
- Audit log extract examples showing key lifecycle events (creation, rotation, grant/revoke, export attempts)
- TLS configuration and cipher list used for in-transit protection to Redwood endpoints
- Statement whether plaintext key export is possible from your environment
- Brief description of access controls around KMS admin principals and separation of duties

If possible, we’d like an initial package by Oct 6 and a more detailed artifact set (signed attestation, rotation logs) by Oct 13. Please let us know your preferred secure transfer method (SFTP, secure Drive link, or direct upload to our intake portal).

Thanks in advance — if it helps, we can schedule a 30-minute walkthrough with our auditors.

Maya Chen
Senior Security Operations
Nova Health

[Attachment note: none attached to this request]

From: Hannah Schmitt <hannah_schmitt@redwood.com>

Date: Tue, 29 Sep 2026 11:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Request: encryption operational onboarding materials & proofs for Nova Health

Hi Maya — thanks for the clear list. We can provide everything you asked for; below is our proposed delivery plan and a couple quick clarifying questions so we scope redaction correctly.

Planned deliverables and ETA:
- Initial package (Oct 1): table-of-contents file with links and a short summary, TLS cipher list, and our high-level operational playbook (PDF). [Attachment: encryption_onboarding_toc.txt]
- Second delivery (Oct 4): rotation_schedule_202609.csv (12-month view), sample audit log extract (redacted), and keystore access matrix (XLSX).
- Final (Oct 12): signed HSM attestation PDF, any vendor certs, and a signed statement re: plaintext export capability.

Clarifications: 1) For audit logs, do you need full principal identifiers (we can provide redacted UIDs + mapping under NDA) or fully anonymized entries? 2) Preferred transfer: we typically use short-lived Drive links (recommended) or inbound SFTP if you provide host details.

Internal notes: CC’ing Irene (security) and Laura (legal) to help with the attestation and any contract/DPA questions. Marissa in SRE will produce the rotation CSV and a sample audit extract.

If that timeline works, I’ll start assembling the package and schedule a walkthrough with your team.

Best,
Hannah Schmitt
Enterprise Sales — Security & Compliance Lead
Redwood Inference

[Attachment: encryption_onboarding_toc.txt (plain text) — TOC listing files we will provide]

From: Irene Choi <irene_choi@redwood.com>
To: Hannah Schmitt <hannah_schmitt@redwood.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>, Maya Chen <compliance@novahealth.com>
Date: Wed, 30 Sep 2026 09:02:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Request: encryption operational onboarding materials & proofs for Nova Health

Hannah — adding technical context and the items we’ll attach.

Summary (high level):
- HSM: Thales nShield Connect 7000 series (clustered), attestation run 2026-09-28, serials included in attestation PDF. HSM enforces non-exportability of customer-wrapped KEKs (no plaintext extraction).
- KMS: We operate a multi-cloud envelope model: AWS KMS (primary production), GCP KMS (secondary for EU regions). DEKs are generated per-tenant; KEKs wrap DEKs in HSM.
- Rotation policy: tenant DEKs rotated every 90 days by default; KEK rotation is an annual operation (with a signed rotation event recorded). We retain rotation metadata for 24 months.
- TLS: TLS 1.3 mandatory on all public endpoints. Cipher suite preference: TLS_AES_256_GCM_SHA384, TLS_CHACHA20_POLY1305_SHA256, forward secrecy with ECDHE. We will attach tls_cipher_list.txt.
- Access control: Admin KMS roles are separated between platform-ops and security; access requires MFA + hardware token + logged justification. We will provide a keystore_access_matrix.xlsx showing principals and roles (redacted as needed).

Planned attachments (deliverable names):
- hsm_attestation_20260928.pdf (signed)
- rotation_schedule_202609.csv (CSV; includes rotation dates and request IDs, redacted principal IDs)
- keystore_access_matrix.xlsx (role-to-principal mapping, partially redacted)
- tls_cipher_list.txt
- audit_sample_202608.csv (sample showing events: create, rotate, grant, revoke; redacted IDs)

Notes/asks:
1) We will not include raw private keys or any plaintext key material.
2) Please confirm if Nova needs decrypted mapping between redacted UIDs and usernames (that would require an executed NDA/POA).
3) Laura — if Nova asks for additional signed legal language about non-export that should be handled through a short addendum; happy to draft.

I can join a walkthrough next week to run through logs and attestations.

Irene Choi
Director, Security Engineering
Redwood Inference

[Attachments promised: hsm_attestation_20260928.pdf; rotation_schedule_202609.csv; keystore_access_matrix.xlsx; tls_cipher_list.txt; audit_sample_202608.csv]

From: Jordan Lee <auditor@veritasassurance.com>
To: Hannah Schmitt <hannah_schmitt@redwood.com>
Cc: Maya Chen <compliance@novahealth.com>, Ravi Patel <procurement@novahealth.com>, Irene Choi <irene_choi@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 02 Oct 2026 15:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Request: encryption operational onboarding materials & proofs for Nova Health — quick follow-up

Hannah/Irene — we received the initial package today (thank you). A couple quick follow-ups from the audit team so we can close this section in our intake: 

- Please provide a CSV rotation log with these columns: rotation_id, key_id, wrapped_key_id, operation, actor_principal (redacted token is fine), timestamp, request_id.
- Please include one sample audit log row for an actual rotation event (create/rotate) with request_id and timestamp.
- Confirmation in writing that the HSM is configured to prevent plaintext export of KEKs and that only wrapped keys are stored outside the HSM.
- Clarify FIPS level for the HSM (we need the exact certification statement: e.g. FIPS 140-2 Level 3).

Requested ETA: Oct 6 COB. If you prefer to share a short-lived Drive link for the CSVs, that works. If any of the items require a legal addendum (e.g., mapping redacted principals), flag that and we’ll pause until the paperwork is in place.

Thanks — Jordan Lee
Senior Assurance Manager
Veritas Assurance

[Attachment: none — sample request for CSV row explained above]
